title: CSCW17 8-round AES-128 Statistical integral / 8-round known key

target.description: 8 nonlinear rounds including initial whitening; finalMC omitted (Section2.1). Public standard AES-128, with known master key and internal-state bidirectional construction.

setting.key_relation: One public known AES master key; no XOR-related unknown-key collection.
setting.plaintext_model: Generate N*Ns input/output pairs by working from middle states with N=Ns; test statistical properties on both ends.
assumptions: The normal/chi-square error model assumes sufficiently large sample/projection parameters and independent output/structure statistics. Journal PDF9/printed763 footnote2 explicitly notes that strongly related projections can violate this iid condition. Mini-AES moderate-error experiments do not establish the full-AES negligible-error tails.
setting.reference_model: Classical known-key (KK) AES-128 distinguisher: construct N^2 plaintext/ciphertext pairs whose input and output byte-count statistics satisfy a key-independent relation checked directly on the texts, without guessing outer-round offsets. Compare with an adaptive forward/inverse uniform-random-permutation oracle under the source statistical/independence model; account for both construction and statistical verification work.

time.note: Two passes ofN^2 computations; no automatic conversion into AES encryptions.

data.note: Source rounds N=Ns=2^20.81 but reportsN^2=2^41.61; retain published rounding.

preprocessing.note: No numerical amount is reported for this resource.

field_conflicts.label: Chi-square scaling and moment derivation
field_conflicts.description: Proposition1 states decreasing finite-population moments D*f and2*D*f^2, f=(2^s-N)/(2^s-1), consistent with the scaled chi-square sentence, Corollary1 Eq8 and independently recomputed endpoints. The final proof line instead prints reciprocal factors f^-1 and f^-2. Adopt Proposition1/Eq8 as the source model and retain the inconsistent printed line as a typo; iid and normal-tail accuracy are separate model conditions.
